– MPH Health Care AG (ISIN: DE000A289V03; “MPH”) intends to sell up to 927,755 existing no-par value bearer shares in M1 Kliniken AG (ISIN: DE000A0STSQ8; “M1”) to institutional investors by way of a private placement through an accelerated bookbuilding process. The final placement price and the number of shares actually placed will be determined in the course of the bookbuilding process. “With the planned placement, we aim to broaden the institutional shareholder base and enhance the tradability of the M1 share. At the same time, our continued majority shareholding underlines our long-term commitment to M1 and to the further development of the company.” - Patrick Brenske, CEO of MPH Health Care AG Assuming full placement, MPH would continue to hold approximately 11.4 million M1 shares and would thus remain the majority shareholder. The placement will be made exclusively from MPH’s existing shareholding. M1 is the central holding within MPH’s portfolio and operates 59 clinics in ten countries under the M1 Med Beauty brand.

The bookbuilding is to commence immediately after publication of this announcement on 19 November 2026, following the close of trading on Xetra. The order book may be closed at short notice. The price and the placement size will be determined upon completion of the process; the results of the placement are expected to be announced on or around 19 November 2026.
The shares offered carry full dividend entitlement for the financial year 2026.
MPH entered into a three-month lock-up undertaking in respect of its M1 shares remaining after the placement, subject to customary exceptions.
Trade Date is scheduled for 20 November 2026 and Settlement Date is scheduled for 24 November 2026.
Cantor is acting as Sole Global Coordinator and Sole Bookrunner for the placement.

MPH Health Care AG is a listed investment holding company headquartered in Berlin. Its focus is on the development and long-term value creation of equity investments, particularly in growth segments of the healthcare market. M1 Kliniken AG is MPH’s strategic core holding.
